summary: Iteration 3 backend regression after main agent added PUT /api/sessions/{session_id}/times. Re-ran the full /app/backend/tests/test_playstation_api.py suite — 31/31 tests PASSED, including all 6 new TestSessionTimesEdit cases (active backdate + recompute, closed session recompute, invalid datetime → 400, missing session → 404, setup, cleanup). No regressions in the 25 prior tests (Rooms, Products, SessionLifecycle, Cafeteria, Reports periods, RoomsReport).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/sessions/{id}/times implementation (server.py L314-351) is correct: validates ISO 8601 via datetime.fromisoformat, supports clearing ended_at via empty string, recomputes elapsed_minutes/play_cost/cafeteria_cost/total_cost via existing compute_play_cost helper, only uses ended_at in compute when status == 'closed' (matches stop_session semantics).
Returns 400 on invalid datetime (Arabic message) and 404 when session id not found — both behaviours covered by tests.
Empty body returns 400 'لا يوجد تحديثات' which is a sensible guardrail.
seed_data_creation: TestSessionTimesEdit creates 2 sessions (one active, one closed) and cleans up the active one in test_cleanup. Closed session is left in history (acceptable, same as iter 2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Frontend was not retested this iteration since main agent only added the missing route. The previously-broken flows (History edit-times modal saveEdit, dashboard quick-adjust -5/-15/-30/-60 buttons) are now end-to-end functional from the API side; main agent can self-verify via UI tap or curl.
rca_of_issue: Previously missing endpoint PUT /api/sessions/{session_id}/times has been added at server.py L314-351. Behaviour verified: (a) accepts started_at and/or ended_at as ISO strings, (b) updates Mongo, (c) recomputes elapsed_minutes/play_cost/total_cost, (d) returns updated Session model. All 6 targeted tests + 25 regression tests pass.
